title: Killa Grape Ice Nic Pouches - 13.2mg / pouch
description: Killa Grape Ice Nicotine Pouches offer a balanced nicotine experience with the vibrant taste of ripe grapes, complemented by a cool icy finish. Each pouch contains 13.2mg of nicotine, making it suitable for adult users who prefer a satisfying yet balanced nicotine release. The Grape Ice flavour provides a refreshing combination of fruity sweetness and a crisp, cool sensation, delivering a smooth, long-lasting and enjoyable taste. These pouches are entirely tobacco-free, providing a clean and convenient alternative to traditional nicotine products. The discreet design of Killa Grape Ice pouches makes them ideal for use in various settings, whether you're on the move, at work, or in a social environment where traditional nicotine use isn’t feasible. Killa Nicotine Pouches are crafted with an emphasis on consistency and quality, ensuring a reliable nicotine experience. Simply place a pouch between your upper lip and gum, and enjoy a steady release of nicotine for up to 30 minutes. With 20 pouches per pack, Killa Grape Ice offers a practical and refreshing option for those who enjoy a cool, fruity twist while relieving nicotine cravings. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a steady nicotine release for up to 30min. 2 Place the used nicotine pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch.
